definitions.gloss: lower layer, lower stratum, lower class
definitions.explanation: The bottom level of a layered structure, whether physical (layers of rock, atmosphere) or social (class hierarchy).

examples.english: There are clouds in the lower atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {下層|かそう}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しかった→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: Life for the lower class was harsh.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下層|かそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粘土質|ねんどしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Clay soil extends through the lower layer of the ground.

notes:
{下層|かそう} refers to the bottom level of any layered structure, whether physical or social. Composed of {下|か} (lower) + ⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (layer, stratum). Can also function as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective.

LAYER HIERARCHY:
- ⟦{上層|じょうそう}→上層：24077_jousou⟧: upper layer/class
- {中層|ちゅうそう}: middle layer
- {下層|かそう}: lower layer/class

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下層|かそう}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧: lower class
- ⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下層|かそう}: lower atmosphere
- {下層|かそう}⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧: subsoil
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下層|かそう}: lower stratum of society

REGISTER:
A formal, academic word. Used in scientific writing (geology, meteorology) and social commentary. In everyday speech, ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧ is more common for physical layers.
